title: Champion of the Pill Gathering
summary: Xiao Yan brings out the Bone Chilling Flame, and the Pill Tower elders are amazed that he holds three Heavenly Flames. He uses Spirit Nourishment Powder and Yao Lao's Spiritual Enhancement Technique, and his three-colored thundercloud grows to four colors, then five. The fused Pill Lightning breaks the lightning conductor, so Xiao Yan sends out his Earth Demon Puppet, which absorbs the lightning. Xuan Kong Zi declares Xiao Yan the champion and gives him the Taiyi Soul Technique, and the top ten will enter the Star Region in two days to try to subdue the Three Thousand Burning Flame. Xuan Kong Zi introduces Chairwoman Xuan Yi and Chairman Tian Lei Zi, who ask the finalists to stop Mu Gu from breaking the seal. Zi Yan tells Xiao Yan that her clan raised the Three Thousand Burning Flame and left a dragon seal in it. She plants a dragon seal in him with Ancient Dragon Blood and warns that if he fails, the seal could control him.
